title: Define civic profile and authority-manifest contracts
summary: Specify and implement the neutral validation boundary for versioned civic profiles carrying jurisdiction/body applicability, source stages, scoped capability assertions and reviewed-host authority references. Matter checks integrity and applicability; it does not decide which body has legal power.
in_scope: Parent profile references and narrow overrides
out_of_scope: Hard-coded Kansas/parliamentary law in the core
Automatic acceptance of crawler final/recommendation parsing labels
Changes to a receiving civic authority registry
implementation: Define the JSON Schema and domain adapter types over the common profile contract; include producer/code/schema digest, scope, effective/available-at clocks, source stages and declared capability meanings.

Define authority assertions with source links and distinct unreviewed, supported-source, reviewed-host, disputed, withdrawn and unknown dispositions; review state requires a verifiable host attestation reference.

Resolve exact pinned parent/override chains with explicit applicability and conflict rules; reject cycles, missing parents and equally applicable conflicting overrides rather than choosing the most permissive value.
Supply invented profiles for recommendation-only, act-specific final capacity, unknown capacity and a body that changes during a joint recording; document unsupported rules.
Keep legal categories in domain payloads while the core retains neutral rule/dependency interfaces.

acceptance.criterion: A parser-only final tag never satisfies a reviewed-authority requirement.
acceptance.verification: Run synthetic manifest/assessment fixtures where identical motion text is evaluated with missing, unreviewed and reviewed authority; only the reviewed applicable case can propose the corresponding host action.

acceptance.criterion: Override resolution is deterministic, time/scoped and conflict-preserving.
acceptance.verification: Replay the same profiles with shuffled input order, out-of-period review and conflicting body/category scopes; exact decisions/digests match and conflicts remain named.

acceptance.criterion: The neutral Matter package imports and runs without crawler, DIAT or civic enumerations.
acceptance.verification: Use the core conformance suite and a dependency-boundary test with the civic adapter excluded.

acceptance.criterion: Every accepted manifest is content-bound and refuses broken parent/review references.
acceptance.verification: Mutate parent digest, source hash and attestation scope independently and verify named refusal before assessment.

tests: Recommendation versus final authority for the same act
Same body with different powers for different categories
Missing parent, conflicting override, future review and withdrawn attestation
risks: A universal numeric tier would misrepresent act-specific authority.
Existing sample-derived crawler schemas are looser than the intended Matter contract.

reuse.application: Reuse body/source/alias concepts, preserving source basis instead of copying jurisdiction policy into Matter.
Retain the explicit boundary between parsing a motion and receiver/operator authority.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
